description: 24/7 digital photo frame app for Android tablets with SMB/Samba streaming, customizable transitions, and automated scheduling

userStories.title: Set up 2-module project structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the base project structure with app and core modules configured.
acceptanceCriteria: Configure build.gradle with Android SDK targets (API 26-34)
Set up module dependencies (app depends on core)
Add basic AndroidManifest.xml with required permissions (INTERNET, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, WAKE_LOCK)

userStories.title: Add core dependencies to project
userStories.description: As a developer, I need all required libraries configured for the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Jetpack Compose dependencies (ui, material3, tooling)
Add Kotlin Coroutines and Flow dependencies
Add Hilt/Dagger dependencies with kapt configuration

userStories.title: Define immutable domain models
userStories.description: As a developer, I need core data classes for Photo, SlideshowSettings, and SmbConnection.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Photo data class with @Immutable annotation (path, fileName, lastModified)
Create SlideshowSettings data class (interval, transitionType, shuffleEnabled, schedule)
Create SmbConnection data class (serverAddress, sharePath, username, domain)
Create Result sealed class for error handling (Success, Error, Loading)
Add unit tests for data class copy() and equality

userStories.title: Implement Android Keystore credential encryption
userStories.description: As a developer, I need secure credential storage using Android Keystore API to encrypt SMB passwords.
acceptanceCriteria: Create CredentialStore interface with encrypt() and decrypt() methods
Generate AES key in Keystore if not exists
Add error handling for Keystore failures
Add unit tests with Robolectric for encryption round-trip

userStories.title: Create SettingsRepository with DataStore
userStories.description: As a developer, I need persistent settings storage using DataStore and Keystore for credentials.
acceptanceCriteria: Save/load SmbConnection (server, share, username) - password encrypted via Keystore
Expose settings as StateFlow for reactive updates
Add Hilt module for dependency injection
Add unit tests with test doubles

userStories.title: Create SmbClient wrapper with SMB 2.0+ enforcement
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an SMB client that enforces secure protocols (SMB 2.0+) and provides a testable interface.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SmbClient interface (connect, listFiles, readFile, disconnect)
Implement JcifsSmbClient wrapper around jcifs-ng library
Configure jcifs-ng to use SMB 2.0+ only (reject SMB 1.x)
Add error handling for authentication failures, timeouts, network errors
Extract interface to enable test doubles

userStories.title: Implement SmbPhotoDataSource for recursive folder scanning
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to scan SMB shares for photos recursively with file type filtering.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SmbPhotoDataSource class with scanFolder() suspend function
Implement recursive directory traversal using SmbClient
Return List<Photo> with file paths and metadata
Add error handling for network failures, permission denied

userStories.title: Create PhotoBufferManager with 4-photo LRU cache
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a buffer manager that preloads 4 photos for smooth transitions.
acceptanceCriteria: Create PhotoBufferManager class with getNextPhoto() and preloadBuffer() methods
Implement LRU cache with max size of 4 photos
Preload photos in background using Dispatchers.IO
Use Mutex for thread-safe cache access
Add unit tests for buffer logic and thread safety

userStories.title: Implement ImageCache with Coil and downsampling
userStories.description: As a developer, I need efficient image loading with downsampling to screen resolution (2560x1600).
acceptanceCriteria: Create ImageCache wrapper around Coil library
Configure Coil ImageLoader with disk cache (100MB)
Add custom Fetcher for SMB URLs using SmbClient
Expose load() function returning Bitmap Flow
Add error handling for corrupt images, OOM

userStories.title: Create SlideshowRepository for photo management
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a repository that coordinates SMB scanning, buffering, and caching.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement loadPhotos() to scan SMB share via SmbPhotoDataSource
Add error handling and retry logic with exponential backoff
Add unit tests with test doubles

userStories.title: Build SlideshowViewModel with auto-advance logic
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a ViewModel that manages slideshow state and auto-advances photos at intervals.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement initialize() to load photos from SlideshowRepository
Add auto-advance timer using viewModelScope.launch with delay
Expose StateFlow<SlideshowState> with current photo, isPlaying, error state
Add proper coroutine cancellation on ViewModel clear
Add unit tests with Turbine for Flow testing

userStories.title: Build SettingsViewModel for configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a ViewModel that manages settings persistence and validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Load settings from SettingsRepository on init
Implement saveDisplaySettings() for interval and transition
Expose StateFlow<SettingsState> with current settings and validation errors
Add unit tests with test doubles

userStories.title: Create SettingsScreen UI with Compose
userStories.description: As a user, I want to configure SMB connection, slideshow interval, transition effects, and schedule in one screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SettingsScreen Composable with Material 3 design
Add SMB configuration section (server, share, username, password)
Add Display section with interval dropdown (10s, 15s, 30s, 1min, 5min)
Add Transitions section with radio buttons (Fade, Slide, Zoom)
Add Schedule section with start/end time pickers
Add Test Connection button with loading indicator
Observe SettingsViewModel StateFlow and render UI

userStories.title: Create SlideshowScreen UI with photo display
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see photos displayed full-screen with scale-to-fit (letterbox/pillarbox) preserving aspect ratios.
acceptanceCriteria: Create SlideshowScreen Composable filling entire screen
Use AsyncImage from Coil to load and display photos
Set ContentScale.Fit to preserve aspect ratio with black bars
Show loading indicator while photo loads
Show error UI with retry button on load failure
Hide system UI (status bar, navigation bar) for immersive mode
Observe SlideshowViewModel StateFlow and render current photo

userStories.title: Implement Fade transition effect
userStories.description: As a user, I want smooth cross-fade transitions between photos at 60fps.
acceptanceCriteria: Ensure 60fps by measuring frame time with Choreographer
Add transition to SlideshowScreen when photo changes

userStories.title: Implement Slide transition effect
userStories.description: As a user, I want slide/pan transitions between photos at 60fps.

userStories.title: Implement Zoom/Ken Burns transition effect
userStories.description: As a user, I want Ken Burns (slow zoom and pan) transition effects at 60fps.
acceptanceCriteria: Animate scale from 1.0 to 1.2 over 8 seconds
Transition to next photo after animation completes

userStories.title: Add swipe gesture navigation
userStories.description: As a user, I want to swipe left/right to manually navigate photos.
acceptanceCriteria: Add HorizontalPager or custom swipe detection to SlideshowScreen
Show swipe hints on first launch

userStories.title: Implement WorkManager scheduling for daily on/off
userStories.description: As a user, I want the slideshow to automatically start and stop at configured times each day.
acceptanceCriteria: Use WorkManager PeriodicWorkRequest for daily schedule
Acquire/release WAKE_LOCK to control screen on/off
Persist across device reboots using Worker

userStories.title: Add network failure recovery with auto-reconnect
userStories.description: As a user, I want the app to automatically recover when SMB connection fails.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement exponential backoff retry logic in SmbClient
Add NetworkCallback to detect WiFi state changes
Show error dialog with manual retry button
Continue slideshow with buffered photos during disconnect
Add Crashlytics logging for network failures

userStories.title: Add memory leak detection and prevention
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to prevent memory leaks for 24/7 operation.
acceptanceCriteria: Add memory monitoring every 60 seconds in production
Implement preemptive cache clearing at 75% memory threshold
Add emergency restart at 90% memory threshold
Log memory usage metrics to Crashlytics
Add unit tests for memory threshold logic

userStories.title: Implement global exception handler for auto-recovery
userStories.description: As a user, I want the app to automatically recover from crashes without manual intervention.
acceptanceCriteria: Log crash to Crashlytics before restart
Preserve last slideshow state in DataStore
Add crash counter to prevent restart loops (max 3 restarts/hour)

userStories.title: Add first-time setup flow with SMB configuration wizard
userStories.description: As a new user, I want a step-by-step wizard to configure the app on first launch.
acceptanceCriteria: Step 1: Welcome screen explaining the app
Step 2: SMB configuration form with test connection
Save settings and navigate to SlideshowScreen on completion
Show wizard only if no SMB connection configured

userStories.title: Add PII logging policy with custom lint rule
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to ensure no credentials are logged to prevent security leaks.
acceptanceCriteria: Create custom Lint rule to detect Log.d/e/i calls with 'password', 'credential', 'secret' keywords
Add LogWrapper class that filters PII from log messages
Replace all Log.* calls with LogWrapper.*
Add static analysis check to CI/CD pipeline

userStories.title: Add Crashlytics integration for monitoring
userStories.description: As a developer, I need real-time crash reporting and analytics for production monitoring.
acceptanceCriteria: Add custom keys for debugging (SMB server, network state, memory usage)
Add breadcrumb logging for slideshow state changes
Test crash reporting with forced crash in debug build
Configure Crashlytics dashboard alerts for crash rate >1%
